topic: The prime-residue, divisibility, prime-quotient and polynomial-column conjectures for OEIS A355257
title: Sharp quotients and column polynomials: alternative proofs for OEIS A355257, revision 37, Comments, after Benyattou-Mihoubi (2017) and Fried (2025)

creators.name: Wenlin Zhang
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: With alternative prime-residue proofs following Benyattou and Mihoubi (2017, Proposition 8) and Fried (2025, Theorem 1), we prove the four statements labelled Conjecture in Luschny and Tebni's OEIS entry A355257, revision 37, Comments, including its A355259 column-polynomial statement. For the logarithmic coefficient array A(n,k), every prime column has residue -1, and k divides A(n,k) holds exactly for nonprime k >= 1, apart from k = 4, whose residue is always 2. The quotient A(n,p)/(p-1) is integral and congruent to 1 modulo p for every even row; evenness is necessary only at p = 3,5. A factorial coefficient expansion also gives fixed-row recurrences, asymptotics, and an integer-parameter extension.
summary: Complete written proofs cover all four A355257 conjectures, the prime-residue conjectures in A355407 and A355414, column identities, fixed-row recurrences and asymptotics, and an integer-parameter extension. The all-row prime residue follows from Benyattou-Mihoubi's 2017 Lah-polynomial theorem through an explicit identification and row identity; Fried's explicit row-three proof, recorded December 17, 2025, and its 2026 presentation are credited. The 2022 OEIS coefficient sums and earlier r-Lah formulas are acknowledged. Finite exact checks and the identified Lean declarations have distinct scopes.
